spec.name: sprint36_cross_venue_spread_kalshi_polymarket
spec.hypothesis: Kalshi and Polymarket misprice economically-identical binary contracts (matched by resolution-criteria text, not title) by 1.5-4.5% net of fees, per IMDEA's $40M/yr estimate; monitoring-only, no trade until measured.
spec.power_argument: Requires >=300 matched-contract snapshot-pairs across >=30 days to estimate spread frequency/size distribution at t=2; min detectable net edge = 150bps after venue fees, above documented noise floor.
